description: Search the catalog of components by text, category, subcategory, manufacturer and specification filters. Returns the total number of matches and, for each of the first results, the product id, name, manufacturer, category, key specifications and the URL of its profile.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1 to 25, default 10).

manufacturer.description: Manufacturer id or part of its name.

query.description: Words to look for (name, manufacturer, type).

specs.description: Specification filters by specification id: a number range {"min": 10, "max": 50} (in the SI unit when the specification has one) or a text that must be contained.

name: search_components
title: Search components
